'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are an intermediate step in the process of turning [[story|storie]]s into [[chapter]]s, and potentially [[book]]s. To craft a chapter, the player will need at least three notes of any quality. The penalty to the overall quality in each step is significant, though there are multiple methods to overcome this.
